message.reasoning:
The user wants me to compare two images and select the correct description of the action.

Looking at the first image: The robot arm holds a clear container (cup) tilted over an empty clear plastic cup. There are nuts (brown objects) inside the container being poured. The cup below appears mostly empty, maybe a few nuts just starting to fall.

Looking at the second image: The robot arm holds the container, now appearing mostly empty (transparent, no visible nuts inside). The clear plastic cup below now contains a pile of nuts at the bottom.

So between the two frames, the nuts that were in the container have been poured into the cup below. The container now looks empty, and the cup has accumulated the nuts.

Let's evaluate the choices:
A. Robot arm lifted the cup. - No, the arm is pouring, not lifting the cup.
B. Robot arm poured all the nuts into a cup. - The container appears empty in the second frame, suggesting all nuts were poured.
C. Robot arm poured some of the nuts into a cup. - This would mean some remain in the container. In the second image, the container looks empty/transparent with no visible nuts.
D. Nothing happened. - False.

Looking carefully at the second image, the container is clear and empty. The cup below has a substantial amount of nuts. In the first image, the container had a full load of nuts and the cup was empty. So it looks like all the nuts were poured.

Thus B is the most accurate.

Let me double check the first image: container full of nuts, cup empty. Second image: container empty, cup full of nuts. So all nuts transferred. Answer B.

The instruction says answer directly with only the letter.
